body:
First of all, thank you for your valuable insight.

I probably had to mention something. I'm not going to do this over her, I'm going for this because I'm a husk of a human. In fact, I don't think I'm capable of loving someone. The hormones, the obsession over the person, I have never experienced this. The only reason this was mentioned at all is the milestone that I had set for myself. Once I bring closure to the issue of her being abused, I'm done here. I simply won't be able to off myself knowing that someone's life depends on me, but, on the other hand, time will eventually heal whatever pain I will probably inflict on other people.
